paragraphs: The “Sporting Goods” category is a top-level department in Shopify’s product taxonomy. It brings together the product families assigned to Sporting Goods, providing the starting point for classification throughout this branch of the catalog. Its immediate branches include Athletics, Fitness & General Exercise Equipment, Indoor Games, Outdoor Recreation.
